title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP06a-auth — change-trusted-base authorization for protected change obligations
goal: Add the base change-trusted-base authorization that the CP06a change PR will consume, and record D22 and D23 with the CP06 checkpoint split, without changing any trusted component.
acceptanceCriteria: The authorization record is schema-valid and generated from the prepared CP06a revision, listing its trusted component paths, base and head tuples and base validation suites.

D22 records revocation-only deletion of unused authorizations and D23 records the obligation model, the CP06a to CP06d split, fail-closed operations and the bound report; Plan 06 section 17 and the plan pair index both list them.
No trusted component changes, nothing is deleted, and all 13 required checks pass.
